annotations.title: Add or change my VCB project

description: create adds a new project to the signed-in member's Vibe Coding Builders page. A new project is not public until the VCB team reviews it; the answer says review: waiting. A create makes the member's builder page public in the Builders list when the page has a name and 1 or more areas of expertise. update changes the standout fact and its source link (standout_source_url), next step and 4 build answers of one of the member's own projects; these changes are live at once. The name, tagline and link change only on the project's edit page (edit_url). A 409 result on create means the link is already listed. Limits: 3 new projects a day; 10 project changes in 10 minutes and 40 a day.

fields.description: For update: the project story fields to change. Only the fields sent change.

build_answers.description: All 4 answers as a whole; an empty answer is left out, and all empty clears them.

standout_source_url.description: A full http(s) link, or null to clear it.

id.description: For update: the id of one of the member's own projects, as the member's page lists it.

ai_tools.description: The AI tools used to build it, for example Claude Code, Cursor.

category.description: For example Productivity, Developer Tools, Education.

infrastructure.description: Hosting and data, for example Vercel, Supabase.

tagline.description: One line that says what it does.

website_url.description: A public http(s) link to the project.
